what: per-cycle admission trace for the failing seeds and uplift-matched improving seeds, block 2 cap 20
status: EXPLORATORY replay. Same seeds and harness; recording is behaviour-neutral, proven by the hash check.
resolution: The trace is at the prediction-window resolution: it sees the rows each sleep cycle admits to prediction. `structure_edges` aggregates all six structure types from the stored candidate snapshots, and the window touches only some of them, so a covered edge can exist without ever appearing in a window. Coverage is therefore not fully attributable from this trace, and no event-level claim about which admission produced a covered edge is made.

field_notes.never_asserted -> admitted_then_absent: world edges that appeared in a window but are not in the final asserted set
field_notes.lost_edges -> in_asserted_not_admitted: final covered edges that never appeared in any admission window
field_notes.covered_in_window: covered edges that did appear in at least one window
field_notes.covered_outside_window: covered edges that appeared in no window (other structure types)
